plan.scope: Post-study exploratory analysis plan fixed before this inference computation; not preregistration of the original study
plan.tests: Two-sided centred circular block bootstrap of paired mean metric differences; basic95% marginal intervals; Newey-West Bartlett HAC cross-check
plan.multiplicity: Holm across all contrasts and nine outcomes within each declared family, population and block setting. Unavailable tests occupy their planned family slots as p=1 for adjustment.
plan.assumptions: Conditional retrospective universe/inventory. Weak dependence and sufficiently stable finite-moment origin-metric process are required. Structural change and short-sample tail ratios limit inference. Adjustment does not undo adaptive design or establish an untouched-test winner.
